newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico peso shrugs off inflation, trades firmer.
newsitem.headline: Mexico peso shrugs off inflation, trades firmer.

text.p: Mexico's peso contracts opened firmer in weak holiday trade, shrugging off a strong inflation number for the first two weeks of December, dealers said on Tuesday.
Dealers said that the market shrugged off the higher than expected inflation for the first two weeks of December, which came in 2.34 percent, much higher than expected.
Inflation for the full month is still expected to come in at about 3.2 percent, dealers said.
The same-day peso contract was trading 0.2 of a centavo stronger at 7.8130/7.8180 per dollar.
The 24-hour peso contract was trading 0.5 of a centavo stronger at 7.8240/7.829, while the spot 48-hour contract was 0.85 of a centavo stronger at 7.829/7.834 per dollar.
